results.generated_sql:

  AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'

results.question: 2025 年每个月的退款率是多少？（退款率 = 已完成退款金额 / 销售额 × 100）
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    strftime(r.refund_time, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount,
    SUM(o.pay_amount) AS sales_amount,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) * 100 AS refund_rate

        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,

    FROM order_items oi

results.question: 2025 年各渠道的销售额相比 2024 年同比增长了多少？请给出渠道、2024 销售额、2025 销售额和增长率（百分比）。
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
    c.channel_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount END), 0) AS sales_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount END), 0) AS sales_2025,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount END), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
            (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount END), 0)
             - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount END), 0))
            * 100.0
            / COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' THEN o.pay_amount END), 0)
        , 2)
    END AS growth_rate_pct
FROM channels c
LEFT JOIN orders o
    ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
    AND o.status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成')
    AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY c.channel_id

results.question: 2025 年的订单中，用户相邻两次有效下单之间间隔天数的中位数是多少？
results.generated_sql:
WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        order_time,
        LAG(order_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS prev_order_time
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成')
      AND order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        date_diff('day', prev_order_time, order_time) AS gap_days
    FROM valid_orders
    WHERE prev_order_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    median(gap_days) AS median_gap_days
FROM intervals
